subject: general
question: Which of the following has successfully test-fired an indigenously developed 500 kg class guided bomb from a Sukhoi combat jet at Pokhran in Rajasthan in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**DRDO**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** successfully test fired an indigenously-developed 500 kg class guided bomb from a Sukhoi combat jet at Pokhran in Rajasthan.
 
• The test firing of the guided bomb came two days after the Indian Air Force successfully test fired the aerial version of the supersonic BrahMos cruise missile from a Sukhoi jet at the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
 
• The BrahMos cruise missile travels at a speed of Mach 2.8, nearly three times that of sound.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **CSIR's mission** is "to build a new CSIR for a new India", and CSIR's vision is to "Pursue science which strives for global impact, the technology that enables innovation-driven industry.
